title: palaquium hayatae
intro: Palaquium hayatae, commonly known as the Hayata palaquium or the Taiwanese palaquium, is a species of flowering plant in the family Sapotaceae. This plant is prized for its potential health benefits, which include its ability to aid in the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and gastrointestinal issues due to its anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Palaquium hayatae are primarily attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins that exhibit antioxidant, antimicrobial, and analgesic activities. Research suggests that the bioactive compounds in Palaquium hayatae may also have immunomodulatory and anti-cancer effects.
